items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I had already met Duke in Chicago. We went to hear . . . to a concert there. They had Django Reinhardt . . . was visiting. ... I was so thrilled to meet him.

ctx.x: At that time maybe it was, for sure.

But that certain era . . . you asked me who I hung out with. I was thinking about it after you left. I was more, in the beginning, drawn into people that Jimmy knew, and that kind of music, and just got away from it gradually, later on, after I got in the Hickory House. I think I had already met Duke in Chicago. We went to hear . . . to a concert there. They had Django Reinhardt . . . was visiting. He was the soloist or guest artist with the band. But talking about a bad habit. He sure had one. He just would have…
Oh, very much so. A discography.
